name: Incident — 1 Week (Extended Response)
description: Extended one-week incident response template covering the full lifecycle: detection, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review. Suitable for major incidents requiring sustained response.

groups.name: Legal & Compliance
groups.description: Legal review, regulatory reporting, and compliance

groups.name: Executive
groups.description: Senior leadership escalation and strategic decisions

items.title: H+0: INCIDENT DETECTED
items.description: Initial detection. Document: who detected it, how, what system/data affected.

items.title: H+0: Incident Classified & IC Assigned
items.description: Incident severity classified (P1/Critical). Incident Commander formally appointed.

items.title: H+1: Incident Bridge / War Room Opened
items.description: All key responders assembled. Roles and responsibilities confirmed.

items.title: H+1: Executive Notified
items.description: C-suite and board informed. Escalation path and spokesperson designated.

items.title: H+2: Immediate Containment
items.description: Emergency containment — isolate affected systems, revoke compromised credentials.

items.title: H+4: Evidence Preservation
items.description: Forensic evidence captured before any remediation that might destroy artefacts.

items.title: H+4: First External Communication
items.description: First customer / public communication if required. Prepared statement reviewed by Legal.

items.title: H+6: Regulatory Notification Assessment
items.description: Legal reviews whether regulatory breach notification is required (GDPR 72h clock, etc.).

items.title: Day 1 Closing SITREP
items.description: End-of-day situation report to leadership. Status, containment effectiveness, next 24h plan.

items.title: Day 2: Root Cause Deep Dive
items.description: Technical team conducts full forensic analysis to determine root cause and scope.

items.title: Day 2: SITREP to Executive
items.description: Updated brief to C-suite. Scope confirmed, timeline to recovery estimated.

items.title: Day 3: Eradication Phase Begins
items.description: Remove threat from all systems. Patch vulnerabilities. Reset credentials.

items.title: Day 4: Recovery Planning Approved
items.description: Executive approves recovery plan. Resources and timeline confirmed.

items.title: Day 4: Regulatory Report Filed (if required)
items.description: Submit mandatory breach notification to relevant regulators.

items.title: Day 5: System Recovery & Validation
items.description: Restore systems from clean backups. Verify integrity before going live.

items.title: Day 6: Full Operations Restored
items.description: All systems verified clean and operational. Incident Response phase ends.

items.title: Day 7: Post-Incident Review (PIR)
items.description: Full post-incident review. Timeline walkthrough, root cause, lessons learned, action items.

items.title: Day 7: Lessons Learned Report Published
items.description: PIR findings documented and distributed. Improvement actions tracked.
